svg.title: Locally weighted regression
svg.desc: Left: a wavy scatter, with the points near a query at x = 6 drawn darker; a bell-shaped weight curve centred on the query; and the straight line fitted to the weighted points, whose value at x = 6 is the prediction. Right: repeating this at every x traces a curve; a very narrow bandwidth gives a jagged curve, a moderate one follows the data, and a wide one is nearly a straight line.
